about: Curated stops for the northern corridor, west (Highway 63, the Mackenzie and Yellowknife highways, Highway 16 west of Prince George, the Stewart-Cassiar and 37A, the North Klondike Highway), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Built 2026-11-22 from osm-stops leads over the 2026-11-16 planet; BC rest areas from the DataBC rest area layer. lat, lon, reach_mi, season and heading steer placement; every other key is the stop as the game reads it. A stop whose season is not 'year round' is left out.

truck_access.about: Stops whose tractor-trailer access was read from a source (a provincial list, a truck stop brand, a cardlock name or a large_vehicles tag), and those where it is assumed with the reason in source. The assumed ones are town stations and unnamed rest areas on long links with no truck source either way.
